newsitem.title: USA: Eugene Island 135 platform being installed.
newsitem.headline: Eugene Island 135 platform being installed.

text.p: Enron Oil & Gas Co is installing a platform over the #1 and #2 wells on Eugene Island block 135 with production anticipated in the third quarter, Box Energy Corp said Thursday.
It said drilling has been completed on the #2 well and pipe has been set to a depth of 19,224 feet.
Box Energy said it has a 15 percent working enterest in Eugene Island 135 which is operated by Enron Oil.
Box Energy also said the #3 well at Moselle Dome in Jackson County, Miss., found 376 feet of Tuscaloosa and Eutaw san oil pay.

Noting the Tuscaloosa oil gravity is abgout 14 degrees, the company said the well will require a pump to produce, adding productionfacilities are being installed. Box has a 79.5 percent working interest.
